planning_route_chosen.calendar_Z: a specified admitted and sealed test calendar/panel, held fixed for seed-axis inference
planning_route_chosen.primary_metric: arithmetic mean over seeds of individual RMSE on all fixed panel endpoints
planning_route_chosen.practical_theta_j: E_seed[W_s_j | Z] > 0 iff relative_mean_gain > .02, provided rival risk > 0
planning_route_chosen.sampling: Independent training seeds; pairing across all models within each seed. Dates and seed-date rows are not independent replicates. Deterministic rivals repeated by reference without fake model fits.
planning_route_chosen.explicit_scope_limit: A conditional mean over randomly initialized training procedures on fixed test calendars, not the historical long-run process target Psi. No assertion of temporal-process generalization from seed-only p-values.
planning_route_chosen.historical_Psi_preserved: Psi_m=E_seed[sqrt(E_time[squared_error_m|seed])]; prior crossed P1/P2/MCS remained unvalidated and are not adopted as approved methods
planning_route_chosen.no_silent_alternative: Changing to sqrt(E_seed,time squared error), an ensemble RMSE, or a temporal MSE objective requires a new prospective version, not outcome-driven substitution

attribution_controls_separate: V3 atom_mse_only with its original cohort/version/scales; not automatically part of the new confirmatory family
V5 full seoi_mse with adverse state preserved
family.support_projection_proposal: Use the historical common max(raw,sqrt(A)) for every point predictor, store both raw and projected outputs. Freeze this policy in each system identity; do not change a frozen recipe silently.
family.inputs_and_fairness: Same raw 7x5 OHLCV and available history, dates, labels, search opportunities, external processing and information set. Candidate intrinsic local normalization is the mechanism under investigation, recorded separately from external preprocessing. Cross-over normalization sensitivity cannot replace any rival.
family.hyperparameter_policy: Candidate hyperparameters are identity-frozen (AdamW lr.003,batch32,max40epochs,patience8,clip1,weight_decay0,HPO false). Each benchmark must bind its original validation-selected recipe. No new candidate HPO or epoch policy may be inserted under this identity. Assess equal opportunities and full-family fitting rules before final protocol; no approved new-panel fair-budget claim.
family.optimization_budget: unresolved actual numbers; freeze after fair-budget feasibility audit; compare configurations, epochs, total wall/GPU time and SAE combined phases

panels.old_D00_D03: exposed development only; archived reserved_confirmation labels do not certify current reserve
panels.task: one-next-bar forecast of unannualized rolling 7-return volatility, ddof=0, same raw OHLCV dimensions
panels.split_policy: Chronological train/development-selection/development-planning/calibration if used/test; embargo by raw close support, not calendar-day arithmetic. All boundary samples whose eight-close target/input support intersects adjacent partitions are removed by rule, never by loss.
panels.sealed_test_choice: Use a custodian-sealed never-examined window if verifiable, otherwise collect dates after the complete protocol/exposure lock. Calendar need not be future as a universal rule. T fixed from power before test release; no optional stopping based on performance.

margin.MAE_secondary: absolute units; no candidate selection by final MAE

methods.name: paired_seed_t
methods.unit: independent paired training seed; calendar held fixed
methods.p_rule: two-sided Student t(R-1), require positive mean; direction failure yields decision p=1
assumptions: iid sampled seed units, models paired within seed
finite nonzero variance; exact Student law only with normal seed differences, otherwise justified asymptotics and tail calibration
methods.F2_Table4_status: not explicitly listed for F2; paired t is listed elsewhere with Nadeau-Bengio for resampled partitions, which are absent here
methods.p_export_policy: Always retain p_raw_two_sided, signed statistic and mean/shift direction. Also export p_positive_direction_decision (raw p when favorable, otherwise1); never overwrite the raw p with the direction-gated decision value.

methods.name: paired_seed_bootstrap_t
methods.unit: paired seed vector; all models and their complete common date vector travel together
methods.statistic: observed t and centered bootstrap-t; recompute studentizer for every draw
methods.p_rule: (1+count(abs(t_star)>=abs(t_obs)))/(B+1), positive mean required; exact discrete rank/CI inversion fixture
assumptions: iid seed vectors independent of fixed evaluation calendar
nondegenerate variance and sufficiently high finite moments
bootstrap extreme-tail approximation validated at the actual family threshold
methods.F2_Table4_status: seed bootstrap is not the stationary temporal bootstrap listed for F2
methods.p_export_policy: Always retain p_raw_two_sided, signed statistic and mean/shift direction. Also export p_positive_direction_decision (raw p when favorable, otherwise1); never overwrite the raw p with the direction-gated decision value.

methods.name: paired_seed_Wilcoxon_signed_rank
methods.equality_estimand: symmetric location/shift of D_s | Z; not an arbitrary-distribution mean
methods.practical_estimand: symmetric location/shift of W_s | Z; not an arbitrary-distribution mean
methods.statistic: exact signed-rank statistic; zero differences excluded only from signed-rank effective n, retained in all mean/metric records
methods.p_rule: exact two-sided p with prespecified deterministic handling of tied absolute ranks and zeros; direction must be positive; no unlabelled normal approximation
assumptions: independent continuous symmetric seed differences about a common location
finite mean only when linking a symmetric location to a mean
symmetry of D does not imply symmetry of W; each needs its own planning evidence
methods.F2_Table4_status: Wilcoxon appears in F1/F5, not as a listed F2 seed procedure; this is a proposed seed-axis adaptation
methods.p_export_policy: Always retain p_raw_two_sided, signed statistic and mean/shift direction. Also export p_positive_direction_decision (raw p when favorable, otherwise1); never overwrite the raw p with the direction-gated decision value.

multiplicity.primary_family: C1,C2,C3 x 20 rivals x {EPA D,practical-margin W}; single Holm family
multiplicity.primary_decision: For every rival require all six Holm-adjusted p<.05 and favorable mean/shift directions; report the largest adjusted p. Missing/unsupported test retains its slot with decision p=1 and no success.
multiplicity.additional_families: Each additional panel keeps its own complete120-slot positive-direction family. A separate declared180-slot negative-direction D family across all3 additional panels protects the adverse-inferiority screen. Raw bilateral p remain visible, even when a positive-direction decision is1. Ablations/subgroups/robustness have named separate families; full-rule validation includes the new inferiority screen.
multiplicity.MCS: separate temporal MSE global diagnostic at declared alpha=.05 proposal; candidate singleton is not a candidate-specific signed pairwise p or an effect-margin test
multiplicity.why_120: Conservative explicit project design, not a universal guide count; primary equality and practical claims are both protected. No truncation by favorable ranks.

p_record_contract.p_raw_two_sided: unmodified bilateral p, including significant negative effects
p_record_contract.p_signed_statistic: signed statistic, mean(D/W), and signed-rank direction/estimand recorded
p_record_contract.p_positive_direction_decision: raw bilateral p if favorable direction, otherwise1; this conservative decision gate is not relabelled as the raw p
p_record_contract.p_Holm_primary: Holm across120 positive-direction decision slots per panel; unmodified bilateral p also exported
p_record_contract.p_negative_direction_decision: for D only, raw bilateral p if negative direction, otherwise1; reuse same raw statistic/resamples
p_record_contract.p_Holm_additional_inferiority: Holm across180 slots=3 additional panels x20 rivals x3 methods on D. A significant negative direction from any prespecified valid procedure fails the no-significant-inferiority condition; unsupported procedures cannot certify absence of inferiority.

additional_inferiority_family.name: ADDITIONAL_PANEL_INFERIORITY_D
additional_inferiority_family.control: single Holm across all180 negative-direction D decisions
additional_inferiority_family.data_reuse: same raw bilateral D p and fitted predictions, no new fits or invented extra independent observations
additional_inferiority_family.failure_rule: any supported method/panel/rival has adjusted negative-direction p<.05 -> consistency fails; all mean gain and other adequacy requirements still apply
additional_inferiority_family.absence_of_rejection: does not prove equivalence or noninferiority; report power/CI and supported scope

effects_and_intervals.raw_effect: mean(D_s), paired seed SD and d_z=mean(D_s)/sd(D_s), with assumptions/uncertainty
effects_and_intervals.relative_effect: 1-mean(RMSE_candidate)/mean(RMSE_rival), ratio-of-means, not mean of per-seed ratios
effects_and_intervals.CI: Paired-seed bootstrap-t difference intervals and paired ratio intervals; publish marginal 95% plus simultaneous intervals at a prespecified family coverage. Discrete ties and p/CI inversion checked.
effects_and_intervals.effect_threshold: paired d_z>=.2 when meaningful and justified for these paired seed units; not Cliff delta from unpaired date rows
effects_and_intervals.effect_threshold_status: guide permits Cohen when applicable; preserve definition and do not switch effect size after outcome
effects_and_intervals.degenerate_scale: if sd(D)=0, no invented infinite effect; record deterministic/degenerate status and use the prespecified supported policy

R3_claim_requires: all 20 main-panel mean RMSE favorable and >2% proposed practical margin
all three method families for EPA and practical alternatives favorable after Holm in the supported scope
non-negligible applicable effect and favorable 95% CI
mean gain against every rival in >=2 of the 3 additional panels; no significant inferiority to any rival in any additional panel
adequacy, calibration/residuals as applicable, validation-test consistency and robust conclusion
actual F2 correspondence justified; no automatic credit from seed-only methods
same-identity R1/R2 evidence; author understanding/defense remains an authentic academic act, not a fabricated software receipt
decision_rule.adverse_outcome: report no R3 superiority; retain all p/CI/failures; no candidate/control substitution
decision_rule.pipeline_failure: stop opening new final endpoints; preserve incomplete receipt and checkpoints; resume only identical source/data/seed/job identity
decision_rule.additional_inferiority: Any valid prespecified significant negative D result after the separate180-slot Holm screen fails additional-panel consistency. No negative bilateral p is hidden by the primary positive-direction p=1 policy. No-rejection is not equivalence.

final_design.arithmetic_only_not_power: 2^(1-R)<.05/120 first holds at R=13 without ties/zeros. This conservative first-rank resolution bound is not a mathematical lower bound for every possible ordering of the full Holm vector and is not a sufficient final seed count or power certificate.
